description: Zonal sums of the WorldPop 2020 children rasters over the 14 Jamaican parishes of OCHA COD-AB Jamaica v01 (admin level 1, boundaries valid from 2024-08-02). Tabular Parquet, 14 rows, join key adm1_name (or adm1_pcode JM01-JM14, the COD-AB codes) to the parishes Collection of the ocha-cod-jamaica catalog. Columns pop_0_4, pop_5_9, pop_10_14, pop_15_19, pop_0_19, pop_total, plus n_cells (100 m cells assigned) and n_cells_edge (coastal cells assigned by the touching-polygon fallback). Modelled estimates, not a census count; compare with the 2011 census counts in ocha-cod-jamaica/population-statistics.

links.title: WorldPop Jamaica 2020: children by age band (100 m, modelled)

table:columns.name: adm1_name
table:columns.description: Parish name exactly as in OCHA COD-AB v01 (e.g. 'Saint Andrew', never 'St.'); join key to ocha-cod-jamaica/parishes.adm1_name.

table:columns.name: adm1_pcode
table:columns.description: COD-AB v01 P-code JM01-JM14 (alphabetical; Kingston = JM03). Not the COD-PS P-code.

table:columns.name: n_cells
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): settled 100 m cells assigned to the parish (cell centre inside the polygon, plus edge cells); 1,756 (Hanover) to 19,822 (Saint Catherine), total 105,986.

table:columns.name: n_cells_edge
table:columns.description: Derived (CARTO): of n_cells, coastal cells whose centre is outside every polygon and that were assigned to a touching parish (ALL_TOUCHED fallback); 943 in total.

table:columns.name: pop_0_4
table:columns.description: Modelled children aged 0-4 in 2020 (WorldPop m_0 + f_0 + m_1 + f_1), fractional persons.

table:columns.name: pop_5_9
table:columns.description: Modelled children aged 5-9 in 2020 (WorldPop m_5 + f_5), fractional persons.

table:columns.name: pop_10_14
table:columns.description: Modelled children aged 10-14 in 2020 (WorldPop m_10 + f_10), fractional persons.

table:columns.name: pop_15_19
table:columns.description: Modelled population aged 15-19 in 2020 (WorldPop m_15 + f_15); includes 18- and 19-year-olds.

table:columns.name: pop_0_19
table:columns.description: Modelled population aged 0-19 in 2020 = pop_0_4 + pop_5_9 + pop_10_14 + pop_15_19; 14 rows sum to 843,119.

table:columns.name: pop_total
table:columns.description: Modelled total population 2020, all ages (WorldPop jam_ppp_2020_constrained); 14 rows sum to 2,774,891.

title: Children by parish, Jamaica 2020 (WorldPop zonal sums, modelled)
